newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.

text.p: Dutch bonds sagged in late trade to close around the day's lows and dealers said they expected to see further downside in the short term.
"I think we'll see lower prices on Monday," said one dealer who believed guilder bonds would now track the June bund future lower after it failed to get above 101.00 on Friday.
Dutch bonds would probably follow their familiar pattern of not fully matching sharp moves up or down by bunds, he said.
In the medium term debt markets were expected to grope about for direction now that the recovery from the lows hit earlier this month on rate-hike woes seemed to have run out of steam.

Yield spreads versus Germany were stable, though some see scope for Dutch outperformance given scant supply of new Dutch government bonds and the guilder's recent stabilisation after a slight bout of weakness against the mark earlier this year.
The government plans just one bond issue in the second quarter of this year, which it will announce on May 23.
The guilder was trading at 1.1241 guilders per mark late on Friday compared with lows of around 1.1265 in March.
